description: Urban Development Authority - Notice of approval of the Development Plan for the Urban Development area of Part of the Hakmana Pradeshiya Sabha Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property-related matters, specifically the approval of a development plan for an urban development area in the Hakmana Pradeshiya Sabha area. The content focuses on land use planning and zoning changes under the Urban Development Authority Law, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4). While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, it does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his ministerial title, and the core subject matter is land development rather than government personnel or structural changes.
